title: Give every non-draft WMBT at least one acceptance

facts.note: Applies to any plan that declares WMBTs, whether or not the current change touches it; a plan-artifact classifier (path/kind) must be confirmed or added to locate WMBTs and their acceptances.

The coverage validator flags every non-draft WMBT with zero linked acceptances that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list, including pre-existing violations; its findings must be wired to activation. Not restricted to any phase or diff event.

fires: A plan contains a non-draft WMBT that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list and has no linked acceptance, including a pre-existing one discovered while doing unrelated work (code/test-only changes included).
Planner adds a non-draft WMBT that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list and attaches no acceptance.
Planner changes a WMBT that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list from draft to a non-draft status while it has no acceptance.
Planner deletes the last acceptance linked to a non-draft WMBT that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list.
Coverage validator reports a non-draft WMBT with zero acceptances that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list.
doesNotFire: WMBT has status:draft, even with no acceptance.
WMBT is listed on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list, even with no acceptance.
Every non-draft, non-allow-listed WMBT in the plan already has at least one linked acceptance.

given: A plan contains a WMBT whose status is not draft and that is not on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list
when: WMBT acceptance coverage is checked or reviewed (any existing or new WMBT, regardless of what the current change touches)
then: The WMBT must have at least one acceptance criterion linked to it.
prefer: Write at least one acceptance for each WMBT in the same change that adds the WMBT or moves it out of draft.
Keep a WMBT in status:draft until at least one acceptance exists for it.
avoid: Moving a WMBT out of draft before any acceptance exists for it.
Removing the last acceptance of a non-draft WMBT.
Attaching a placeholder or empty acceptance just to satisfy the count (gaming the metric).
Putting a WMBT on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list, or setting it back to draft, just to silence the check.
unless: The WMBT is listed on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list.
why: Acceptance coverage (wmbt_acceptance_coverage) requires every non-draft WMBT to carry at least one acceptance; a WMBT without one has no acceptance to verify it against.
evidence: The coverage validator finds zero non-draft WMBTs without at least one linked acceptance, after excluding WMBTs on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list.
A reviewer confirms each non-draft, non-allow-listed WMBT in the plan links to at least one acceptance.
verifier_detail: For each WMBT in the plan (existing or new, not only changed ones): if status == draft, skip; if its id is on the wmbts_without_acceptance allow-list, skip; otherwise count linked acceptances and flag the WMBT when the count is < 1 (threshold: at least one).
Term wmbt_acceptance_coverage: every non-draft WMBT carries at least one acceptance.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding.

additions.text: A WMBT without one has no acceptance to verify it against.
additions.justification: The source gives no explicit rationale; this is an inferred restatement of the wmbt_acceptance_coverage term, declared as inferred rather than source-preserved. It adds no obligation.

additions.text: Attaching a placeholder or empty acceptance just to satisfy the count; allow-listing or reverting to draft just to silence the check.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-patterns for a count threshold; they add no obligation beyond the source rule. Acceptance quality itself is governed by other planner acceptance conventions (graph).

additions.text: Write the acceptance in the same change, or keep the WMBT in draft until one exists.
additions.justification: Concrete moves that follow directly from the draft exception; no new obligation.

additions.text: WMBT acceptance coverage is checked or reviewed.
additions.justification: Schema needs a When; it is phrased as the check event over all WMBTs so it does not narrow the source's unconditional invariant.
